title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Given an input string `s` containing words separated by one or more spaces (possibly with leading or trailing spaces), return a string of the words in reverse order separated by a single space with no leading or trailing spaces.
constraints: s contains English letters, digits, and spaces, and contains at least one word.
hints: Scan from the right end skipping spaces, extract each word's [start, end] slice, and append it to the result.
Alternatively split on whitespace, reverse the list of non-empty tokens, and join with a single space.

examples.explanation: Reversing the four words gives "blue is sky the".
Leading and trailing spaces are removed when reversing.
Multiple spaces between "good" and "example" collapse into a single space.
